mechanisms.quote: Steal %movespeed_steal_pct%%% movement speed from enemy heroes in %active_radius% range every second.
apply a poison for %slow_duration% seconds, slowing by %slow%%%
Targets an enemy, slowing it for %purge_slow_duration% seconds.

Enemy targets are slowed for %enemy_effect_duration% seconds. Allied targets gain bonus movespeed and %slow_resist%%% slow resistance for %ally_effect_duration% seconds. Caster is always granted the ally benefit on cast.  Both movement speed reduction and increase start at %phase_movement_speed%%% and gradually decrease to 0% over the course of the buff duration.
creates an area that reveals and slows invisible heroes by %movespeed%%%
The double attacks apply a %movement_slow%%% movement slow for %slow_duration% seconds on the first strike.
